measures.title: Advisory Vote Regarding the Use of Consumer Fireworks in Unincorporated Island County
measures.what_it_does: Non-binding advisory vote: asks voters in unincorporated Island County whether the Board of County Commissioners should amend Island County Code Chapter 9.08A to ban consumer fireworks there. Permitted public displays are not affected.
measures.cost_line: No tax or fee; the vote does not change the law.

measures.title: Governmental Services and Technology Levy
measures.what_it_does: Permanently lifts Langley's regular property tax levy to fund continuing city services and update its operating and electronic technology, with the senior and disability exemption.
measures.cost_line: Up to $1.66 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection, $0.65 more than the current $1.01; about $42 a month on a $770,000 home.

measures.jurisdiction: Port District of South Whidbey Island
measures.title: Levy for Renovation and Modernization of Port Facilities
measures.what_it_does: Lifts the port district's regular property tax levy to renovate and modernize port facilities, including the fairgrounds and waterfront, and support economic development and its small business incubator.
measures.cost_line: Up to $0.169 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection, six cents more than the current $0.109.
